name: about-whyus
title: About Why Us
description: A light about block split in two: the studio's values and a five-star client quote on the left, a positioning statement and three big stat cards on the right.
use: An agency needs to answer why choose us with values, a review and hard numbers in one block.
avoid: Copy and numbers are hardcoded, and three stat cards feel tight in the right column.
a11y: The star icons have no role or rating label, though the numeric 5.0 / 5 beside them carries the score. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pale grey page with faint diagonal stripes under a wide two-column layout. The left holds a heavy 'Why us', two rows of tiny icons with labels, five orange stars and an italic quote. The right has a large statement and three white rounded stat cards.
behaves: Hovering a stat card lifts it slightly and deepens its shadow. Nothing else moves in the recording.
customise: Values, quote, attribution and the three stat numbers are inline; card padding and the lift are classes.
weight: light: Static text and three cards with a CSS hover lift.
